in_sanskrit.name: रत्तिक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who protects the chariot of a deity or a king during battle. The chariot is a symbol of power and victory.

in_hindi.name: रत्तिक्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who protects the chariot. In Hindu mythology, the gods often ride chariots during battle, and their chariots are protected by various gods and goddesses.

in_tamil.name: ரத்திக்ஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who protects the chariot. In Tamil literature, the chariot is a common metaphor for power and victory.

in_telugu.name: రత్తిశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who protects the chariot. In Telugu literature and mythology, the chariot is a symbol of power and victory.
